label_definitions.crop-top: A women’s upper garment whose hem clearly ends above the natural waist or visibly exposes the midriff. Crop-top takes precedence over blouse or t-shirt.
label_definitions.t-shirt: A women’s casual knitted tee with a recognizable T-shirt construction. Exclude sweatshirts, hoodies, jackets, dresses and men’s garments.
label_definitions.blouse: A women’s blouse or non-T-shirt upper-body top. Exclude men’s shirts, sweatshirts, jackets, dresses and obvious crop-tops.
label_definitions.reject: Men’s garment, shirt outside project scope, sweatshirt, hoodie, jacket, dress, non-garment, severe occlusion, unusable crop or clearly out-of-scope image.
label_definitions.uncertain: The reviewer cannot reliably distinguish the correct project label.
